# ipzilon_hubs (Data Source)

List hubs. Provide id (singular lookup) or any combination of site_id, name and address_space. Without site_id the lookup is global (IPzilon >= 3.2.0).

## Example Usage

```terraform
# List all hubs in a site
data "ipzilon_hubs" "all" {
  site_id = 1
}

# Lookup a single hub by ID
data "ipzilon_hubs" "single" {
  id = 1
}

# List hubs in a site filtered by address_space or name
data "ipzilon_hubs" "filtered" {
  site_id       = 1
  address_space = "10.0.0.0/16"
}

output "hub_cidr" {
  value = data.ipzilon_hubs.all.items[0].address_space
}

# Lookup a hub by its address space only, without site_id (IPzilon >= 3.2.0).
# Without site_id the CIDR is compared as a network: it must have no host bits.
data "ipzilon_hubs" "weu" {
  address_space = "10.0.0.0/16"
}

output "weu_hub_id" {
  value = one(data.ipzilon_hubs.weu.items).id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `address_space` (String) Filter: address_space match (server-side). With site_id it is an exact text match; without site_id it compares the network, so the value must be a CIDR without host bits.
- `id` (Number) Lookup a single hub by ID. Cannot be combined with site_id; name and address_space are ignored.
- `name` (String) Filter: exact name match (server-side).
- `site_id` (Number) Filter: hubs of this site. Optional: without it the lookup is global (IPzilon >= 3.2.0).

### Read-Only

- `items` (Attributes List) Matching hubs; an empty list when nothing matches. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items))

<a id="nestedatt--items"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items`

Read-Only:

- `address_space` (String) Hub address space CIDR.
- `description` (String) Free-text description.
- `id` (Number) Hub ID.
- `location` (String) Free-text location label.
- `name` (String) Hub name.
- `site_id` (Number) ID of the site the hub belongs to.
